decisions.reason: As a close-to-core finishing machine with only one year of market exposure and low strategic distance, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open while demand evidence accumulates.

Although it is more distant from the established portfolio, the prominent launch and Germany-premiere signaling suggest enough unresolved upside in print enhancement to justify keeping this exploratory option for now.
Because it builds directly on the firm's established automation offer, the cost of continuation is likely limited and the first year is too early to conclude that its value will not materialize.

The new B2 multifinisher fits the firm's core postpress direction and was highlighted prominently at launch, so management would retain it while the market reveals whether larger-format demand scales.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is closely aligned with the firm's booklet-making business, making it a sensible option to continue while customer adoption becomes clearer.
This add-on unit already shows an installed-use reference customer and extends an existing platform, so the early positive signal supports keeping it on the market.
